descriptions.normal: An exquisite-looking dish. The ham's sweetness is locked inside the fresh vegetables, drizzled with a spicy broth. Delicious is an understatement.
descriptions.suspicious: An exquisite-looking dish. Food ingredients of different degrees of doneness are wrapped in shriveled vegetables. It looks depressing to say the least.
descriptions.delicious: An exquisite-looking dish. The sweetness of ham and the crisp lotus seeds are a match made in heaven. The aromatic broth pours down like the dawning light, caressing your tongue with an unworldly delicious taste.

effectTexts.normal: Increases all party members' ATK by 272 and CRIT Rate by 8% for 300s.
effectTexts.suspicious: Increases all party members' ATK by 224 and CRIT Rate by 6% for 300s.
effectTexts.delicious: Increases all party members' ATK by 320 and CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s.
